args.content:
HAWAII VACATION PACKING LIST
June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel documents (flight confirmations, hotel reservations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera with extra batteries/memory cards
- Travel insurance information
- Medications and prescriptions
- Reusable water bottle

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2 sets)
- Lightweight, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners and shopping
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Sleepwear
- Undergarments
- Socks and underwear
- Hat with wide brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

FOOTWEAR:
- Flip-flops/sandals
- Water shoes for snorkeling
- Comfortable walking/hiking shoes
- Dressier sandals for dinners

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Snorkel gear (mask, snorkel, fins) - optional if not renting
- Waterproof phone case
- Beach bag
- Quick-dry clothing

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots/shoes
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Long-sleeve shirt for sun protection
- Rain jacket (weather can change quickly)
- Small backpack for day hikes
- Insect repellent

SPECIAL OCCASIONS:
- Luau attire (aloha shirt, floral dress, etc.)
- Semi-casual outfit for nice dinners

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Razor
- Makeup (if desired)
- Contact lenses and solution (if needed)

ELECTRONICS:
- Phone charger
- Camera charger
- Portable power bank
- Universal adapter (if needed)
- Headphones

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books/e-reader for relaxation
- Travel pillow for flights
- Snacks for travel days
- Small first aid kit
- Hand sanitizer
- Tissues
- Ziplock bags for wet items

REMEMBER:
- Check baggage allowance for your airline
- Leave room in luggage for souvenirs
- Pack reef-safe sunscreen to protect Hawaii's coral reefs
